reviewContext.scope: earn/gig slot — round-2 re-review of round-1 FAIL fixes
reviewContext.note: No manifest.json found for this feature under .vcsdd; review conducted disk-only per the round-2 instructions. Tooling note: Bash was not available in this context, so node --test / run.sh were NOT executed — all judgments are from static reading of the on-disk code and tests.

evidence.description: auditNoHuman scans every executable for stdin reads / interactive prompts / ask-human patterns; FORBIDDEN regex set is real and comment-stripped before scan.
Asserts zero violations on the real slot files AND that planted human steps are caught (audit is not a no-op).
Loop spawns the skill with stdio ['ignore','pipe','pipe'] — stdin physically ignored, so the slot cannot block on a human.
settle's record-earn dependency contains no stdin/prompt read either.
do_settle never sets earn itself; earn_usdc is parsed ONLY from record-earn's chain-verified 'VERIFIED +X USDC' line; detect/bid/deliver always emit earn_usdc 0.
Only EXTERNAL inflows (from âˆ‰ MY_WALLETS) are summed; self-transfers contribute 0; block-cursor based; fail-closed. A weak model cannot fabricate income.
Gates are observation-only; earnFromSettle returns ONLY externalEarnUsdc. gates.test asserts V1..V4 pass => still $0.
settle passes NO model-controlled args to record-earn and does not set FOUNDER_TEST, so test seams stay closed and the real RPC + pinned wallet are used — no injection vector.
wallet_address emits only an address-shaped field (0x, len<=44); never a key-shaped value.
available_rails reads only env KEY NAMES (grep '^...=' then strips '='), never the secret values.
bid-run's output JSON contains task/jobId/title/bid_ok/http only; the DEALWORK_API_KEY and the HTTP body are never printed.
Plants BLOCKRUN_WALLET_KEY + SOME_PRIVATE_KEY and asserts they never appear in stdout/stderr, incl. the ANICCA_ARGS settle path.
POSITIVE: mode is genuinely driven by $ANICCA_ARGS (the real loop channel), GIG_MODE only a fallback; run.sh always exits 0; each mode is bounded by inner timeouts under SKILL_TIMEOUT_S.
POSITIVE: laborx is no longer in the offered rails; only action-complete dealwork is returned.
